description_en: Deletes a zone of an endpoint
description_zh: 调用RemoveZoneFromVpcEndpoint接口，删除终端节点的可用区
kebab_example: aliyun privatelink remove-zone-from-vpc-endpoint --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id eu-west-1a --endpoint-id ep-hp33b2e43fays7s80000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RemoveZoneFromVpcEndpoint

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the endpoint for which you want to delete the zone. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
要删除可用区的终端节点所属的地域ID。
您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html接口获取地域ID。

parameters.help_en: The ID of the zone that you want to delete
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint for which you want to delete the zone
parameters.help_zh: 要删除可用区的终端节点ID
parameters.name: endpoint_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run, without performing the actual request. Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): performs a dry run and performs the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会删除可用区。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。
